extras.name: Dyemaster Marna
extras.finding: SAME NPC AS OUR "Dyemaster Mara": period Marna at CapnBry zone 26 loc 27487,22873 -> Camelot 35679,31065 z8208; our Dyemaster Mara <Dye Merchant> (list EnamelDye3) stands at 35671,31141 z8208 (76 units). Period Allakhazam mob 1383: Albion Merchant (Enamel Dye).
extras.proposal: rename Dyemaster Mara -> Dyemaster Marna (spelling) and give her the period enamel stock (her period items vs EnamelDye3 in the stock check below); the earlier first-name match to "Marna" (craft components) was wrong

extras.name: Ylaine Barret
extras.finding: period Allakhazam mob 4573 (2003-11-01) calls her a Quest NPC with known loot Greater Enervating Poison, Isle of Glass (Gothwaite Harbor); CapnBry 4405 "Ylaine Barrett" Merchant at Isle of Glass 522790,542142: same as our Ylaine Barrett (spelling).

extras.name: Dala
extras.finding: Dala is the Midgard mithril weapon merchant in Jordheim (Warcry patch 1.60 notes "A high level (mithril) one-hand weapon shopkeeper has been added to Jordheim by name of Dala"; CapnBry 1794 at our Dala's exact spot). The 7 Albion item pages naming her are Allakhazam listing errors.

extras.name: Darbo
extras.finding: Darbo is the Hibernian Sapphire-seal armour merchant in DF (period Allakhazam mob 2870); the 1 Albion page is a listing error.

extras.name: Debo
extras.finding: Debo is the Albion Emerald-seal merchant (period mob 3634; CapnBry sees him in DF and also in Camelot City); the 1 Hibernian page (Malign Scarab Cloak) is a listing error.

extras.name: Eluned
extras.finding: Eluned is the Mag Mell (Lough Derg) cloth-armour merchant (period mob 1630; CapnBry 2025 at our Eluned's spot, 20 units); the 1 Albion page is a listing error. Her Hibernian stock list is in new_lists.json (pass 2).
